summary: Session/vehicle state reset routine called per-frame from sub_4C6B60. When the global session type dword_7C56A4 is <= 6 (non-qualifying session) and the object condition at obj+0x32C8 (reached through the pointer at this+0x0) is <= 1, it re-initializes the AI racing line via AIRacingLinePathFollowing, downgrades the mode flag this+0x60 from 2 to 1, and resets the three float fields this+0x18/0x1C/0x20 to -1.0f. Regardless of those guards it unconditionally clears the status flags this+0xA8/0xAC/0xB0/0xB4/0xD0/0xD4, then returns the value read at entry (the session type, or the object condition when the guard failed).

operations.description: Read the global session type dword_7C56A4; the reset body runs only when the type is <= 6 (non-qualifying session).
Load the object pointer stored at this+0x0 and test the per-object condition flag at obj+0x32C8; the reset body runs only when the condition is <= 1.
Invoke AIRacingLinePathFollowing on the object racing-line subobject (object base + 12) to re-initialize path following.
Guard on the mode flag at this+0x60: when it equals 2, downgrade it to 1.
Reset the three float fields this+0x18, this+0x1C and this+0x20 to -1.0f.
Unconditionally zero the status flags at this+0xA8, this+0xAC, this+0xB0, this+0xB4, this+0xD0 and this+0xD4 (a mix of dword and byte flags).
Return the value read at entry (the session type from dword_7C56A4, or the object condition at obj+0x32C8 when the guard failed); called from the frame-path ticker sub_4C6B60.

unresolved: Whether `this` is the vehicle array slot itself or a controller object holding a vehicle pointer (this+0x0) is unconfirmed; the object reached at this+0x0 is treated as the vehicle/object for the racing-line and condition checks.

Semantic purpose of the per-object condition at +0x32C8 (tested <= 1) and of the cleared flags this+0x60/0xA8..0xD4 beyond 'reset to default' depends on the caller sub_4C6B60 and is not determined here.
The owner type SessionStateObject is DERIVED from the legacy ABI label 'State_Reset_on_Session_Condition' and the reset semantics; no independent class evidence exists.
